Callout.Name: Exposure - Cold
Callout.Message: Walker found cold and disoriented on the ridge.
Callout.Advisory: Shivering stopped, caller has him out of the wind.

Script.Line: The fog came down and the path went with it.
I sat behind a wall for a while. That made it worse, not better.
I cannot get warm. I have been shaking for an hour and I cannot get warm.

Callout.Patient: I lost the path in the fog. I thought I was going the right way.

Lines.Approach: He is out of the wind with the caller. The shivering has stopped, which is not good news.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
